audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and First item all contradicted their own why-strings: the chart gave Yone Levels 2 and 3 while whys[1] and whys[2] read "stays Kled's" and "remains Kled's", gave Skill at 4-5 and 6 while whys[3] and whys[4] say mounted Kled out-trades you, and gave Yone First item while whys[5] says "skill-decided".
audit.why: The packet chart reads Kled on rows 1-5 and the mirror audit flipped the same rows on Kled's side. Mounted Kled with courage genuinely out-trades a pre-item Yone.
audit.corrected: Flipped rows 1-4 to Kled and row 5 to Skill on BOTH layers as one atomic group, and rewrote the five phase whys under them.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere; phases[4].why said "Kled's ultimate changes the math too" without saying how.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s with a shield and 3500-4500 range, against Fate Sealed's 120/100/80s. Bear Trap is 11/10/9/8/7s and Jousting 13/12/11/10/9s — those are the two windows a trade actually turns on.
audit.corrected: Wrote the real numbers into phases[3].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t was a placeholder ("His engage hook. Dodge it"), the displacement duel that decides every trade was never mentioned, and Jousting's re-cast was absent entirely.
audit.why: Both champions carry displacement — Bear Trap yanks the target toward Kled, Mortal Steel's third cast knocks airborne — so the trade belongs to whoever lands first. Jousting can be re-cast to dash back through the initial target, which is why disengaging after his first dash does not work.
audit.corrected: Rewrote report[5].t around the displacement race and put the Jousting re-cast into breakdown.cooldowns and the trade lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t recommends "Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern" and breakdown.late says "anti-heal stays core".
audit.why: Kled has no healing ability. His passive restores Skaarl's courage and remounts him "with a portion of" Skaarl's health — that is a remount, not a heal, and the kit carries no heal flag. Recommending an anti-heal item as core here spends 800 gold on nothing.
audit.corrected: Replaced the anti-heal line with Plated Steelcaps against Violent Tendencies' four fast attacks, and dropped the anti-heal clause from breakdown.late.
sources: mirror audit kled__yone found the same leaked line

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: His burst opens on an attack wind-up, not a visible cast — the fourth attack of the four is the big one, so the time to leave is before the first, not after the cast.

notes: Kled has no heal in his kit — the page was recommending Executioner's Calling as core and calling the remount 'healing' in three places. Yone's W is a shield, not sustain: two content fields said 'outheals' and are corrected.
